name: Phillip
headline: Turn 3 Danmark’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile and broadband subscriptions, 3LikeHome, 5G internet and iPhone deals to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive for Black Weeks or for a family plan.

Usage across mobile, roaming and family lines is the strongest signal you have for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for family plans, roaming and home internet are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per subscriber, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per subscriber from usage, roaming trips and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each line and tested continuously in app, SMS and email.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the family plan when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan or add-on per subscriber, triggered by real usage. Customers already on 3LikeHome stop getting blanket upgrade mails, and those who would benefit get the offer.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every line in use, every week
cases.text: Personal offers for roaming, streaming and home internet in app, push and email, so every subscriber has a reason to use what they already pay for.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
